stem: What was one effect of the arrival of the American Expeditionary Forces in Europe during World War I?

options.label: A
options.text: Italy left the Central powers alliance.

options.label: B
options.text: The heir to the Austro-Hungarian throne was assassinated in Sarajevo.

options.label: C
options.text: The Allies were able to launch a major counterattack on the western front.

options.label: D
options.text: Russian forces were able to withdraw from the eastern front.
